sentences.en: Obscurity is by no means a proof of deep thought.
sentences.zh: 模糊和深刻的思想之间并没有必然联系。

sentences.en: He lived and died in obscurity.
sentences.zh: 他默默无闻地生，也默默无闻地死。

sentences.en: I'm afraid of losing my obscurity. Genuineness only thrives in the dark. Like celery.
sentences.zh: 我害怕失去我的不出名状态。真诚只在暗处生长，就像芹菜一样。

senses.zh: 不明, 费解, 隐晦, 无闻 晦涩或不明的事物
